user.title: Connect to your SOLIX Link gateway
user.description: Enter the local HTTP or HTTPS URL. A gateway bearer token is required for controls and for authenticated gateways.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure gateway
reconfigure.description: Update this gateway's address. Leave the token field untouched to keep the current token; an explicitly empty token removes it.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without embedded credentials or URL parameters.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read a valid SOLIX Link device list from the gateway.

init.title: Energy estimates
init.description: Enable newly discovered energy entities. Power-history estimates work across supported models and modes; native observed estimates cover Standard AC on tested Gen 2 firmware. These are estimates, include bypass and must not be added together for the same consumption. Existing entity choices are preserved. History and native report collection must be enabled on the gateway.

data.native_energy_enabled: Enable newly discovered native energy sensors
data.history_energy_enabled: Enable newly discovered AC energy estimates

price_policy.name: Owned price charging policy
price_policy.description: Price policy using the shared charging owner. C1000 Gen 2 1.1.4.9 only. Release before switching to surplus; persistent plans continue while HA is offline.

price_entity.name: Price sensor
price_entity.description: Fresh price in currency/kWh. Thresholds use this same unit.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Preview sends nothing. Apply needs armed. Release clears only a confirmed owned plan. Reset clears ownership only after an empty Standard plan is present.

override.name: Manual override
override.description: Hold leaves the persistent plan unchanged.

charging_policy.name: Owned charging policy
charging_policy.description: Preview or apply one owned price-plan or surplus-power operation. Only C1000 Gen 2 1.1.4.9; release the current owner before switching policy. No output switching. Uncertain results require reconciliation.

price_entity.name: Price sensor
price_entity.description: Fresh price in currency/kWh. Thresholds use this same unit.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Preview sends nothing. Apply requires arming. Release restores only this policy’s confirmed baseline. Reset is read-only after the baseline has been restored manually.

override.name: Manual override
override.description: Hold leaves the persistent plan unchanged.

policy.name: Policy
policy.description: Price and surplus share one durable owner per station.

export_entity.name: Grid export sensor
export_entity.description: Fresh W, with positive values meaning export. Confirm the sign before arming.

set_tou_plan.name: Set Time-of-Use plan
set_tou_plan.description: Store or activate a schedule on a gateway-enabled C1000 Gen 2 or C2000 Gen 2 using native MQTT. Peak can discharge the battery with mains connected. Use Return to grid to confirm grid supply.

enabled.name: Enable Time-of-Use
enabled.description: Activate the plan, or store it while in Standard mode.

periods.name: Periods
periods.description: Up to six non-overlapping periods with tariff (peak, mid_peak, off_peak), start_hour and end_hour. Use whole hours 0–24; split overnight periods.

charging_storage.title: Charging ownership could not be restored
charging_storage.description: Automatic charging is blocked. Check HA storage permissions and the SOLIX Link diagnostics. Preserve the ownership file and inspect the station before restoring a known-good backup. Do not delete it to force a retry.

charging_reconciliation.title: Charging control needs review: {station}
charging_reconciliation.description: A command result is uncertain or settings changed manually. A saved plan or power limit may still be active. Inspect fresh settings, restore the policy baseline explicitly if appropriate, then use the matching charging_policy reset action. Reset sends no station command; output switching is unnecessary.

charging_signal.title: Charging signal is stale: {station}
charging_signal.description: The armed charging policy has no usable fresh price/export reading. Check the sensor unit, freshness and automation. The last saved setting remains in place; stale signals do not pause charging or clear a persistent plan. Disarm and release the matching owned policy if appropriate.

native_energy_continuity.title: Native energy statistics are blocked: {station}
native_energy_continuity.description: The persisted HA continuity check rejected this meter ({reason}). Raw diagnostics remain available. Preserve HA and gateway state, inspect permissions or backup/reset evidence, and restore a current valid source. Do not delete continuity files or energy statistics to force acceptance. A new meter epoch must start after the last accepted observation.

energy_quarantine.title: Energy counter continuity needs review: {station}
energy_quarantine.description: The observed energy meter stopped accepting deltas ({reason}). Existing totals are retained. Inspect counter/firmware/reset evidence with the calibration workflow and restore documented continuity before resuming. Do not delete HA energy statistics or infer missing battery energy.
